Pyro-Dendro Resonance isn't actually a mechanic in Genshin Impact — elemental **resonance** refers only to party-wide bonuses from having two characters of the same element in your team (e.g., Pyro Resonance gives +25% ATK, Dendro Resonance gives +50 Elemental Mastery and boosts reactions). There is no specific bonus called "Pyro-Dendro Resonance."

You may be thinking of the **Burning** reaction, which occurs when Pyro meets Dendro. Burning deals Pyro damage over time to enemies affected by it. It can also be extended or spread when additional Dendro is applied, and interacts with other reactions like Quicken (Dendro + Electro) — for example, applying Pyro to a Quicken-affected enemy can trigger Burning.
